description: Finds individual court-authorized wiretap orders as published in one annual US Courts Wiretap Report. Defaults to the latest report year; filters use the report year, court, state, jurisdiction, offense group and intercept type. A row was reported to the courts in that report year and may have ended earlier. Results and costs are per order as reported. The annual headline count undercounts that year because some orders are reported in later years. Related orders can share people, intercepts and arrests, so do not sum those fields across rows. Zero or blank means none reported, not that nothing happened. Flags identify missing prosecutor reports and implausible figures. A missing row is not proof that no surveillance occurred; the published order shards start in 2016.

limit.description: Maximum order rows returned; default is set by the register, allowed 1-100. Never sum people or intercepts across orders.

offense_group.description: Offense group label from the register, for example drugs.

report_year.description: Report year; defaults to the latest published year. Each row is an order reported in that year; late reports can raise later counts.

state.description: State name as printed in the register, for example TEXAS.

type.description: Interception type code from the register lookups.

name: wiretap_orders
title: Find Reported Wiretap Orders
